title: Sourdough Discard Bagels

components.name: For the Bagels
ingredients: 200g sourdough discard, unfed, at room temperature

components.name: For Topping
ingredients: 1 egg white + 15g water for egg wash
Toppings of choice (sesame seeds, poppy seeds, everything bagel seasoning, etc.)
directions: Combine flour, 1 tablespoon granulated sugar, instant yeast, and salt in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook. On low speed, add sourdough discard and water until combined. Increase to medium and knead for 4–5 minutes until a smooth ball forms. Add more water or flour (1 tablespoon at a time) as needed. Dough should not be sticky.
Grease a large bowl, transfer dough, and cover with plastic wrap. Let rise for 90 minutes or until doubled.
Turn dough out and divide into 8–10 equal pieces. Roll each into a smooth ball, press thumb through the center, and stretch the hole to form bagel shape. Cover and rest 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment. Bring a pot with 2 quarts of water and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar to a boil.
Boil bagels 15–30 seconds per side. They should float. Remove with a slotted spoon, let excess water drip off, and transfer to baking sheets.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with toppings.
Bake for 18–22 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool fully before slicing.

notes: To use active sourdough starter: omit commercial yeast and replace discard with active starter (200g). Increase rise times. Mini bagels: divide dough into 24 pieces (about 46g each).
